examples.arabic: هو شاف أصحابه علي ومنى جنب محل الفاكهة.
examples.english: He saw his friends Ali and Mona next to the fruit shop.
examples.transliteration: Howa shaf ashabo Ali w Mona gamb mahl el faka.

examples.arabic: شفت راجل بيشتغل في محل وقلت له السلام عليكم
examples.english: I saw a man who works in a shop and I said to him peace be upon you.
examples.transliteration: Shoft ragel biyeshtaghal fe mahal we olteloh as salamu alaykum

examples.arabic: احمد راح المحل عشان يشتري هدوم
examples.english: Ahmed went to the shop to buy clothes.
examples.transliteration: ahmed raah el mahal ashan yeshtery hedoom

examples.arabic: انا شفت حاجة حلوة اوي في المحل
examples.english: I saw a very nice thing in the shop.
examples.transliteration: ana shoft haga helwa awy fi el mahal

examples.arabic: انا رحت المحل وشفت الراجل اللي بيشتغل هناك
examples.english: I went to the shop and saw the man who works there.
examples.transliteration: ana roht el mahal we shoft el ragel elly biyeshtaghal henak

examples.arabic: احمد راح المحل عشان يرجع القميص
examples.english: Ahmed went to the shop to return the shirt.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed raah el mahal ashan yeraggaa el amees
